newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil June 16-July 15 Fipe inflation at 0.92 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil June 16-July 15 Fipe inflation at 0.92 pct.

text.p: Brazil's inflation, as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe), dropped to 0.92 percent between June 16 and July 15 versus 1.24 percent in the previous four-week period, the institute said.
The Fipe institute gave the following breakdown of its weighted inflation index for the period:
- Food: 0.33 pct rise in the period
- Housing: 1.22 pct rise in the period
- Transportation: 3.13 pct rise in the period
- Personal expenses: -0.05 pct drop in the period
- Clothing: 0.80 pct rise in the period
- Health care: 0.70 pct rise in the period
- Education: -0.09 pct drop in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures weekly.
